notes.title: Hug Survivor Update: A "Settings Screen" has been added!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43507859/9a374bbf6cbfee5d47ce0a8b09604ff1cef7a95f.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43507859/6e0d625bd3c39253af7efd14aa60566861a7e9ec.png.
①The volume balance of background music and sound effects can be adjusted in fine increments of 10% each. 

②You can also switch between window modes. 
(With a keyboard, you can always use the F4 key to switch window mode.)
(Window mode can be selected from "Full Screen," "Window (Small)," and "Window (Large).")

③ If you clear hard mode, a sound test will be added!!! 
You can listen to all the songs in the game plus the immortal songs!
